name: Frozen Snow Storm in the Sky
source:
I am flawless, but----------

Fubuki believes in himself, yet trembles from a feeling different from his love of the game. 
The world championship of soccer is coming and everyone is lodging together for practice. 
Fubuki wants to focus but, without a clear heart..... 

An Inazuma Eleven BL ADV novel with submissive Fubuki 
Goenji x Fubuki 
Someoka x Fubuki 
Endou x Fubuki, and others 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE077636.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
我明明無懈可擊，可是——

吹雪相信自己的實力，此刻卻在為一種與熱愛足球截然不同的感情而顫抖。世界足球大賽在即，大家住在一起集訓。吹雪想專心踢球，可心緒遲遲無法平靜……

《閃電十一人》BL同人冒險遊戲，吹雪為受。配對包括豪炎寺×吹雪、染岡×吹雪、圓堂×吹雪等。
